answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics: 1) Accuracy@K (Acc@K) determines the fraction of queries for which the top-k results include at least one relevant document. 2) Recall@K calculates the percentage of all relevant documents that are present within the top-k results. 3) Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) computes the average of the inverse of the ranks... 4) Mean Average Precision (MAP) measures the mean precision score calculated after each relevant document is retrieved...
